_comment: 03-03 PDF/X corpus (task 1 structure + task 2 colour/X-1a transparency/master pixels). Expectations are spec-derived from .paul/phases/03-multipage-pdfx/03-03-PLAN.md and the ISO 15930-4/-7 rule families named in each _note; observed output never weakens them. Both base pages are 100x80 mm; 1 mm = 2.834645669 pt. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000 is 2023-11-14T22:13:20Z. The output profile is testfiles/data/colors/default_cmyk.icc (description 'Artifex CMYK SWOP Profile').

x4-basic._note: PDF/X-4 skeleton on the basic fixture: PDF 1.6 with an xref stream and ObjStm, one GTS_PDFX OutputIntent carrying the document CMYK profile byte-for-byte, PDF/X Info keys with pinned dates, two pages whose TrimBox is the page and whose BleedBox is the page grown by the 3 mm inkscape:bleed (MediaBox == BleedBox without marks), no ArtBox, and neither optional content nor annotations (PDF/X-4 allows them only with a Name / outside the bleed, which we drop). Colour: the device-cmyk and output-profile icc-color fills both emit the exact values 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4 as DeviceCMYK, the RGB fills and the sRGB gradient are converted to DeviceCMYK in the output intent, the spot ink stays /Separation with a DeviceCMYK alternate, the RGB image is a DeviceCMYK 8-bit image, and no DeviceRGB/ICCBased colour space appears (the profile is the intent only).

x1a-basic._note: PDF/X-1a:2003 skeleton: PDF 1.3 with a classic xref table and no object streams, the same OutputIntent identity/bytes, the PDF/X-1a Info value, the same page boxes, and no /S /Transparency groups (X-1a has no transparency). Colour: the same CMYK-only rules as x4-basic, plus the X-1a extra rules (no /SMask, no /CA or /ca below 1, no blend mode other than Normal).

x4-marks._note: PDF/X-4 with crop marks. Marks extend the MediaBox to trim + 8 mm per side (max(3 mm bleed, 3 mm) + 5 mm), keep the TrimBox at the page and the BleedBox at 3 mm, and require eight 5 mm registration-colour lines outside the bleed, drawn in /Separation /All with a DeviceCMYK 1 1 1 1 alternate and tint 1. The page content is clipped to the BleedBox.

x1a-marks._note: PDF/X-1a with crop marks: the same mark geometry and registration colour as x4-marks, on the PDF 1.3 skeleton with no transparency groups.

noprofile-refused._note: A PDF/X export needs an embedded CMYK output profile and a non-empty OutputConditionIdentifier. Without a color-profile the preflight reports a document-level error and the exporter throws before capypdf writes anything: the target must be absent and stderr must carry exactly the expected finding ids.

x1a-transparency-refused._note: PDF/X-1a has no transparency and no flattener exists, so each transparent construct is refused before capypdf writes anything. One error per item, in document order, with the item id: opacity, fill-opacity, mask, mix-blend-mode, gradient stop-opacity, image alpha and the rasterized blur filter. The opaque control item is not reported, and the target file must be absent.

x4-transparency._note: PDF/X-4 keeps transparency: the RGBA image and the rasterized blur keep an /SMask, the group opacity becomes a graphics state, and everything is still colour-converted to the output intent (no DeviceRGB, no ICCBased, images DeviceCMYK). Transparency groups may carry /CS /DeviceGray for a soft mask but never /CS /DeviceRGB.

x4-master._note: PDF/X-4 with master layers on three 100x80 mm pages (110 mm apart, 3 mm bleed): every page paints the same cached master and content forms (the 03-02 shared XObject objects), the page boxes are identical, colour stays CMYK-only, and a re-import of each page through Rosepen's own PDF importer shows the master background inside the trim. The importer crops to the TrimBox (probe: 378x302 px at 96 dpi, no bleed), so only trim samples are asserted. The master bg (#c8dcc8) is light and in gamut: +-24 per channel covers the CMYK round trip. Saturated content samples use +-48, justified in the colour data: a #3333cc fill round-trips to about (60,71,157) through the SWOP profile, so +-2 (the direct-render tolerance) is not achievable; the rule asserted is that the master and page content both render.

x4-page2-only._note: Single-page PDF/X-4 export of page 2 (--export-page=2): the prunePages path re-anchors the surviving page and its master content. The export has one page with page 2's trim/bleed boxes, colour is CMYK-only, and a re-import shows the master bg and page 2's own content inside the trim.

x1a-master._note: PDF/X-1a with master layers: the fixture has no transparency, so the export succeeds. Masters use the same cached groups, but on X-1a GroupContext writes plain form XObjects, so the file has no /S /Transparency group at all. Header/boxes/colour rules are the X-1a ones.

default-unchanged._note: The default PDF path must stay unchanged: PDF 2.0, no OutputIntents, no GTS_PDFXVersion and no XMP metadata (none of the PDF/X branches run), while the upstream non-bare-page rule still writes BleedBox, TrimBox and ArtBox. This locks the untouched branch.
